title: Personal VOCs Exposure with a Sensor Network Based on Low-Cost Gas Sensor, and Machine Learning Enabled Indoor Localization.
summary: Machine-learning localization from sensor-network RSSI measurements localized a mobile VOC sensor in a 120 m² indoor test, with reported accuracy above 99%; mapped ethanol measurements correlated with a photoionization detector. The result is a bounded indoor proof of concept. External replication and prospective utility were not established in the reviewed material.
ai_technology: ML models process RSSI measurements for indoor localization of the mobile sensor; the sensor network also measures VOC distribution.
